# Hologram VR: wiring

<!-- Generated by `python -m cad.generate` from cad/products/vr.py. Edit the model, not this file. -->

Pin numbers are physical pin positions on the Raspberry Pi 5.
See `drawings/04_wiring.svg` for the schematic.

| Type | From | To | Notes |
|------|------|----|-------|
| power | 4 x 18650 `+` | UPS board `BAT+` | 4 cells in parallel, in the board's holders |
| ground | 4 x 18650 `-` | UPS board `BAT-` |  |
| power | UPS board `5V` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 2 (5V) | pogo pins under the Pi |
| ground | UPS board `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 6 (GND) |  |
| i2c | UPS board `SDA` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 3 (GPIO2 SDA) | battery fuel gauge |
| i2c | UPS board `SCL` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 5 (GPIO3 SCL) |  |
| power | MPU-6050 IMU `VCC` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 1 (3V3) |  |
| ground | MPU-6050 IMU `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 9 (GND) |  |
| i2c | MPU-6050 IMU `SDA` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 3 (GPIO2 SDA) |  |
| i2c | MPU-6050 IMU `SCL` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 5 (GPIO3 SCL) |  |
| gpio | MPU-6050 IMU `INT` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 7 (GPIO4) |  |
| gpio | Display load switch `CTRL` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 15 (GPIO22) | high = displays on |
| power | Display load switch `VIN` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 4 (5V) |  |
| ground | Display load switch `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 14 (GND) |  |
| power | Dual-panel driver `5V` | Display load switch `VOUT` |  |
| ground | Dual-panel driver `GND` | Display load switch `GND` |  |
| gpio | Control pod `MODE` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 11 (GPIO17) | to GND when pressed, internal pull-ups |
| gpio | Control pod `ACTION` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 13 (GPIO27) |  |
| gpio | Control pod `VOL-` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 33 (GPIO13) |  |
| gpio | Control pod `VOL+` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 29 (GPIO5) |  |
| ground | Control pod `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 39 (GND) |  |
| power | MAX98357A left `VIN` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 2 (5V) |  |
| ground | MAX98357A left `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 20 (GND) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A left `BCLK` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 12 (GPIO18 PCM_CLK) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A left `LRC` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 35 (GPIO19 PCM_FS) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A left `DIN` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 40 (GPIO21 PCM_DOUT) | SD tied to VIN = left channel |
| power | MAX98357A right `VIN` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 4 (5V) |  |
| ground | MAX98357A right `GND` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 25 (GND) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A right `BCLK` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 12 (GPIO18 PCM_CLK) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A right `LRC` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 35 (GPIO19 PCM_FS) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A right `DIN` | Raspberry Pi 5 pin 40 (GPIO21 PCM_DOUT) | SD via 470 k to VIN = right channel |
| audio | MAX98357A left `OUT+` | Speaker L `+` |  |
| audio | MAX98357A left `OUT-` | Speaker L `-` |  |
| audio | MAX98357A right `OUT+` | Speaker R `+` |  |
| audio | MAX98357A right `OUT-` | Speaker R `-` |  |
| video | Camera Module 3 Wide `CSI` | Raspberry Pi 5 CAM0 | 500 mm cable over the crown |
| video | Dual-panel driver `HDMI` | Raspberry Pi 5 HDMI0 | 2880 x 1440, left half = left eye |
| video | Dual-panel driver `MIPI_L` | 2.9in LCD left `MIPI` |  |
| video | Dual-panel driver `MIPI_R` | 2.9in LCD right `MIPI` |  |

## Where each module lives

| Module | Location |
|--------|----------|
| 4 x 18650 | Rear pod |
| UPS board | Rear pod, under the Pi |
| Display load switch | Chin bar |
| MPU-6050 IMU | Optics bridge |
| Control pod | Left side |
| MAX98357A left | Left ear cup |
| MAX98357A right | Right ear cup |
| Speaker L | 40 mm, left ear |
| Speaker R | 40 mm, right ear |
| Camera Module 3 Wide | Above the visor |
| Dual-panel driver | Chin bar |
| 2.9in LCD left | Brow, left eye |
| 2.9in LCD right | Brow, right eye |
